description: This PHP class 'CandidateAttachmentDecorator' provides a wrapper around the 'CandidateAttachment' entity, offering methods to retrieve file content, set candidate references, and manage entity dependencies within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the CandidateAttachment entity, enabling additional functionality and integration within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the associated CandidateAttachment, reading from resource streams if necessary.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the CandidateAttachment by candidate ID.
